gloss: to tweet; to post on social media

definitions.gloss: to tweet; to post on X (formerly Twitter)
definitions.explanation: To publish a short message on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter). By extension, sometimes used loosely for posting on other social media platforms.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}のランチをツイートした。
{有名人|ゆうめいじん}がツイートすると、すぐにバズる。
examples.english: When a celebrity tweets, it goes viral right away.

examples.japanese: {不適切|ふてきせつ}な{内容|ないよう}をツイートして{炎上|えんじょう}した{政治家|せいじか}が{謝罪|しゃざい}に{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: A politician who tweeted something inappropriate and caused an online firestorm was forced to apologize.

notes:
From English "tweet" + する. Despite Twitter's rebrand to X in 2023, the verb ツイートする and the noun ツイート remain dominant in Japanese usage. The platform itself is still commonly called ツイッター by many Japanese users.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ツイートする: to tweet; to post
- ツイートを{削除|さくじょ}する: to delete a tweet
- ツイートが{拡散|かくさん}する: a tweet spreads/goes viral
- ツイートを{引用|いんよう}する: to quote a tweet
- {誤|あやま}ってツイートする: to tweet by mistake

RELATED WORDS:
- ツイート: tweet (noun) — a single post
- リツイート: retweet — sharing someone else's tweet
- バズる: to go viral — when a post gains massive attention quickly
- {炎上|えんじょう}: online firestorm — when a post attracts intense criticism
